notes.subject: הָעַלְמָה
notes.rationale: 'kuñataĩ okakuaapáva' (young woman, with article = a specific one) vs 'virgen' (LXX parthenos / NT Matthew); JPS agrees with 'young woman'.

notes.subject: pe
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks article before אוֹת; Guaraní needs 'pe' here, bracketed.

notes.subject: עִמָּנוּ אֵל
notes.rationale: The name Imanuel is itself the sentence 'El ñande ndive' (God-with-us); kept as one name with the meaning spelled out.

notes.subject: וְקָרָאת
notes.rationale: Feminine singular verb: 'she (the young woman) shall call' — not impersonal; rendered 'ohenóita' with she as subject understood.

notes.subject: David óga
notes.rationale: The sign is addressed to the house of David (v.13 context), 'peinde' = to you (plural).

translation: Upéicha rupi, Adonai voi omeʼẽta peinde ⟨pe⟩ jeʼapa: Ehecha, pe kuñataĩ okakuaapáva oguereko ñembyaty ha romeʼẽta peteĩ taʼyra, ha ohenóita héra Imanuel — heʼiséva «El ñande ndive».
